svg.aria-label: DataForSEO Agent charts in the terminal: a local SEO geogrid of 25 rank tiles lights up on map tiles around a pinned business, green for ranks 1 to 3, teal for 4 to 10, gold for 11 to 20, with Top 3: 9 of 25. The view flips to a US tile map of keyword search volume by state and a sparkline of the 12 month trend draws. 16 chart types.
